system.description:
Your light radiates like ripples in the sky, supercharging a Starlight in range. As a bonus action, by spending 2 Stellar Charges you can select one Starlight you have active, as it becomes supercharged and flashes a blinding unstable white light. All creatures within 10 feet of this Starlight must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they gain 1 rank of Dazzled and becomes a Convergence for the next minute.

Beginning at 7th level, you can select two different Starlight’s as this abilities point of origin. Beginning at 15th level, creatures that fail, gain 2 ranks of Dazzled.
